privacy_policy_intro_body: Hisab ("we", "our", or "the app") is an open-source local group expense application. This policy explains how data is handled on your device.
privacy_policy_permissions_body:
The app may request the following optional permissions only when you use the related local feature.

• Camera — To scan receipts while adding an expense. Images are processed and stored locally.

• Photos / Photo library — To let you choose expense images from your gallery. We only access images you explicitly select.

• Notification access (Android Transaction Scanner) — Only if you enable the scanner. Notification text is parsed on the device, and drafts and history remain local. You can turn the scanner off or revoke access in Android system settings at any time.
privacy_policy_data_collection_body: Hisab does not require an account and does not send app data to a server. Groups, participants, expenses, balances, receipts, scanner drafts, and settings stay on this device unless you explicitly export a backup.
privacy_policy_data_storage_body: Data is stored locally on this device using SQLite. Receipt files are kept in the app's local storage. Exported backups are files that you choose where to save or share.
privacy_policy_data_usage_body: Your local data is used only to provide group expense splitting, balances, settlements, receipt storage, backups, and local scanning. The app has no advertising, account service, or background upload.
privacy_policy_third_party_body: The public app does not use remote account, analytics, billing, or AI services. It uses open-source Flutter, SQLite, and platform-local OCR/scanner components.
privacy_policy_data_sharing_body: The app does not transmit or share your local data. If you export a backup or share a report, that action is initiated by you through the operating system's file or share UI.
privacy_policy_data_security_body: Local data is protected by the device and operating system. Use device security and keep backups in a location you trust. No software can guarantee absolute security or prevent loss of an unbacked-up device.
privacy_policy_user_rights_body:
You can:
- Export your local data at any time (Settings > Data & Backup > Export)
- Import a backup you choose
- Delete local data from this device (Settings > Advanced > Delete local data)
- Disable the local transaction scanner or revoke its Android permission
- Use the app without an account or network connection
privacy_policy_data_retention_body: Your local data remains on the device until you edit, delete, or replace it. Exported backup files remain wherever you saved them until you remove them.
privacy_policy_children_body: This app is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy_policy_changes_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in app updates. We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy_policy_contact_body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository or contact the developer through the app's About section.
